issues.description: Method parameter type inconsistency for addGuestStudents: the textual task in problem_statement.md (line 50) instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String), while the UML diagram in the same problem statement (line 73) and the provided reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (line 90) declare addGuestStudents(int). This contradictory specification (String vs int) can confuse students about the expected method signature and lead to incorrect implementations or compile errors when following one artifact but not the others.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the textual task in problem_statement.md to require addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and reference solution, and add the corresponding method stub to the template (e.g. public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO */ }). If instead a String parameter is intended, update the UML and solution implementation to accept String and document how the String should be parsed/validated.
